youtube.title: What is the coffin corner of flight? #Shorts
youtube.description:
Every flight climbs for about twenty minutes, levels off, then stays there. But higher isn't always better.

Go too high and the air is too thin for the wings to hold the plane up at a safe speed. Pilots call that squeeze the coffin corner: too slow and the wing stalls, too fast and it shakes itself apart. So as a plane burns fuel and gets lighter, it climbs step by step to the best height for its weight.

Full episode on the channel.

#Shorts #aviation #pilot #science #thehiddenwhy
